title: zazz-script-engine verification
description: Checks that cover the whole crate. The tests are unit tests in each module of src/ and src/test/; results are readings and live with CI.

entities.title: Unit tests on macOS and Linux
entities.summary: Each module's tests run in the workspace test on both platforms; native.rs and fdpass.rs are tested over real Unix socket pairs.
entities.details: wasm.rs is compiled only for WASM targets (#[cfg(target_family = "wasm")] in lib.rs), so these host tests do not run it; it runs when daemon's zazz tests build and call real scripts, which is why the test stage needs the wasm32-wasip1 target.
criteria: Every test in zazz-script-engine passes on macOS and on Linux

checks.description: CI's test stage runs it on Linux; the release runs it on the owner's Mac.

entities.title: Branch coverage of at least 95%
entities.summary: CI fails when the tests cover less than 95% of zazz-script-engine's branches, test code excluded.
criteria: cargo llvm-cov reports at least 95% branch coverage for -p zazz-script-engine

checks.description: Run in src/macos by CI's coverage stage (nightly toolchain); test modules carry coverage(off).

entities.title: Builds with the workspace's minimum Rust
entities.summary: The crate compiles with Rust 1.85, the workspace's rust-version.
criteria: cargo check succeeds with the 1.85 toolchain

checks.description: CI's msrv stage runs it with Rust 1.85.
